text:
alex: Heads up — staging KMS-proxy RBAC change tonight 22:00 UTC. We'll drop legacy 'vault-service' and add 'kms-restricted' role. This affects Vault unwrapping of partner-wrapped blobs. Plan is 22:00-22:10 UTC with a small canary. Partner key rotations will follow. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/kms-proxy-rbac-2026

jamal: ack. will be on call. do we expect any prod impact? :thinking:

alex: No prod, this is staging only. But dev environments that still use wrapped blobs via the old path may see 403 on `vault transit/unwrap`. We'll patch their clients. Also need to coordinate partner key rotation — maria, can you own rotating partner-vendor-keys after we confirm RBAC?

maria: I can. timeline: after 22:10 UTC I will start rotation. Steps: 1) create ephemeral SA in partner-project 2) rewrap ciphertext using new key 3) update secret in Vault via `vault write secret/data/...` 4) trigger smoke test.

lee: Quick check — are audit logs going to show the old service name or new role? We need to preserve traceability for the compliance report.

alex: Audit log entries will still be from the proxy service account but will include the new role in the `authorizationInfo`. I added a pre-check to confirm logs show both `principalEmail` and `policyBinding`. Use this query in BigQuery: `SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.* FROM `redwood-logs.kms.audit` WHERE protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail LIKE '%kms-proxy%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50`

jamal: nice. I'll run that pre-check at 21:45 UTC and post screenshots.

security-bot: Reminder — rotation window requires 2FA auth for the rotation scripts. Please ensure your session is active.

maria: Attached snippet I'll use to rewrap (will paste in thread): ```bash
# fetch ciphertext
CT=$(gcloud storage objects get --bucket partner-enc --object secret.ct --format='get(content)')
# decrypt with old key (ephemeral access)
PLAINTEXT=$(gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=- --location global --keyring partner --key old-key <<< "$CT")
# encrypt with new key
NEW_CT=$(gcloud kms encrypt --location global --keyring partner --key new-key --plaintext-file=- <<< "$PLAINTEXT")
# update Vault
vault kv put secret/partner/creds ciphertext=$NEW_CT
```

alex: minor note — don't echo plaintext in CI logs. Use ephemeral pipes and delete variables after. Also set `VAULT_TOKEN` via 1password CLI.

jamal: smoke test plan?

maria: smoke: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/partner-jwt)" https://staging-api.partner/health` expecting 200 within 3s. I'll run 3x across regions.

lee: if any failure, roll back to pre-change snapshot and re-enable legacy role. Who has permission to rollback?

alex: I will. I have owner on staging project. Rollback steps in runbook header. Add '@ops-bot' to trigger rollback script if needed: `/run rollback kms-proxy staging`

ops-bot: Acknowledged. Will watch for `rollback` command and require manual confirm.

jamal: ok team, I'll post pre-change audit query output in ~10m. maria — ping here when you start rotation.

maria: will do. thanks.
